'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]], [[Participants in Operation Enduring Freedom]]
**[[Belgium]] announces that all [[Belgian Armed Forces|troops]] will be withdrawn from [[Afghanistan]] in 2021, bringing an end to Belgian involvement in the war. Belgium currently has around 70 military personnel deployed in Afghanistan, as part of a train, advise and assist role for pro-[[government of Afghanistan|government]] forces. [https://www.brusselstimes.com/news/belgium-all-news/143999/belgium-announces-troop-withdrawal-from-afghanistan-in-2021/ (''The Brussels Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A [[carbon monoxide]] leak kills at least 18 [[mining in China|miners]] at a [[coal mine]] in [[Yongchuan District]], [[Chongqing]], [[China]]. A [[search and rescue]] effort is underway to find six other missing miners. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/05/china-mine-deaths-18-killed-in-underground-gas-leak-in-chongqing (''The Guardian'')]
*A fire partially destroys the [[Middle Collegiate Church]] in [[New York City]], United States. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/wireStory/predawn-fire-guts-church-housing-yorks-liberty-bell-74556460 (ABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Alberta]] reports 1,879 new cases in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://edmontonjournal.com/news/local-news/covid-19-over-one-hundred-patients-in-icu-as-alberta-sets-new-single-day-record-with-1879-new-cases (''Edmonton Journal'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports a new single-day record of 1,859 cases, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 125,385. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/ontario-covid-19-update-december-5-1.5830009 (CBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Quebec]] reports a new single-day record of 2,031 cases, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 149,908. It is also the first time that a Canadian province has reported more than 2,000 cases in a single day. [https://montreal.ctvnews.ca/quebec-shatters-record-with-over-2-000-new-covid-19-cases-reported-in-past-24-hours-1.5218562 (CFCF-DT)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****The [[California Department of Public Health]] issues a [[stay-at-home order]] for the [[San Joaquin Valley]] and [[Southern California]] as part of an effort to reduce the spread of COVID-19. The order will take effect tomorrow at 11:59&nbsp;p.m. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/southern-california-san-joaquin-valley-under-restrictions/2020/12/05/258c48b4-375a-11eb-9699-00d311f13d2d_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/californias-san-joaquin-valley-enacts-stay-home-order-74559288 (ABC News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iowa]]
*****[[Iowa]] reports 960 hospitalized cases, making it the first time the state reported fewer than 1,000 hospitalized cases since November 18. [https://www.thegazette.com/subject/news/health/iowa-covid-19-hospitalizations-drop-below-1000-20201205?template=amphtml (''The Gazette'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pennsylvania]]
*****[[Pennsylvania]] reports 12,884 new cases in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://6abc.com/pennsylvania-covid-19-cases-new-daily-record-12-884/8537415 (WPVI-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Russia]]
*****[[Moscow]] begins to [[vaccination|vaccinate]] high-risk workers with the [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]] at 70 newly opened clinics across the city, marking Russia’s first mass COVID-19 vaccination. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/5/moscow-starts-mass-covid-19-vaccination-with-its-sputnik-v-shot (Al Jazeera)]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[Russia]] increases by a record 28,782 cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2,431,731. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20201205-moscow-starts-vaccinating-high-risk-workers-against-covid-19 (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] reports a record 193 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 5,706. [https://hungarytoday.hu/coronavirus-fatalities-frightening-high-new-cases-saturday/ (Hungary Today)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record 196 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 14,705 as a weekend [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] takes effect. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1772951/middle-east (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] [[Leader of the Labour Party (UK)|Leader]] [[Keir Starmer]] self-isolates after one of his staff members tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-55201080 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
*****[[Pfizer]] announces that it has submitted [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|their vaccine]] for approval in [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-pfizer-india/update-2-pfizer-has-sought-emergency-approval-for-covid-19-vaccine-in-india-govt-adviser-idUSL1N2IM01J (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] surpasses 50,000 total deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-iran-idUSKBN28F0DO (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Tokyo]] reports a new single-day record of 584 cases, according to data from the [[Tokyo Metropolitan Government]], bringing the total number of confirmed cases in the city to 43,377. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/12/05/national/tokyo-record-coronavirus-japan/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]]
****[[Saudi Arabia]] reports less than 200 new cases for the first time since April 4. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1772886/saudi-arabia (''Arab News'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020 Kuwaiti general election]]
**[[Kuwaitis]] turn out to vote for the 50 electable [[National Assembly (Kuwait)|National Assembly]] members in the [[general election]]. [https://news.kuwaittimes.net/website/kuwait-sets-parliamentary-elections-for-december-5/ (''Kuwait Times'')]
*[[Stonehenge]] closes to the public after protesters gathered at the site to protest the [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]]'s plan to build a road tunnel near the monument. [https://apnews.com/article/international-news-england-historic-sites-828f3be7b43b29ecd5c85c16dc21a453 (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[JAXA]] [[space probe]] ''[[Hayabusa2]]'' delivers the first ever subsurface [[asteroid]] samples to [[Earth]]. The capsule, containing a small amount of material from [[Apollo asteroid]] [[162173 Ryugu]], landed in the [[Australia]]n [[outback]].  [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/watch-japan-hayabusa2-mission-deliver-ryugu-asteroid-samples-earth-live-stream-today-2020-12-05/ (CBS News)]
